function.name: cmd_controller_execute
function.description: Executes a system-level command using os.system() on Windows operating systems. It can execute single or multiple commands chained with '&&'. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

command.description: The system command to be executed. To execute multiple commands, separate them with '&&'. For example, 'dir && echo done'.

unit.description: Specifies the unit of measure for the command if applicable. This is not utilized by os.system() directly but can be used for logging or analysis purposes.

message.content: Got it! I’ve noted that you’d like a reminder on **March 27th** to renew your Netflix subscription. If you’d like me to set an actual calendar event or send you a notification, just let me know which app or service you’re using (Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar, etc.) and I’ll walk you through adding it. Otherwise, you can mark it on your personal calendar or set a phone reminder for that date. Happy to help!
message.reasoning: User wants to "make a note on 27th of March this year to remind me for the subscription of netflix". They want a reminder. We can create a note. But we don't have a calendar or note system. We can respond with a suggestion: "Sure, I've set a reminder for March 27th to renew your Netflix subscription." But we can't actually set a reminder. We could ask for a tool to set a reminder? There's no tool. So we can just respond acknowledging.
